snippet.title: INSOMNIA GAME MECHANICS AND FEATURES BREAKDOWN
snippet.description:
Insomnia is a top-down shooter with elements of psychological horror, presented in minimalist pixel art reminiscent of Hotline Miami. The game offers the freedom to choose between a careful stealth approach or loudly eliminating all enemies in your path.

The story follows the protagonist as he gets caught up in street conflicts in a nameless coastal city consumed by crime, lawlessness, and corruption. Will he manage to survive, keep his friends safe, take down his enemies, and — most importantly — hold on to his sanity? That depends on you.
